title: Validate phase-two optimization reporting end to end
description: Run focused outside-in specifications, complete Python and dashboard gates, workbook reconciliation and visual checks, zero-resource diff proof, and a model-backed sandbox lifecycle from approval through terminal child review. Production mutation, deployment, push, and champion promotion remain out of scope.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Release integration resumed after the required Tactus package was published. Tactus 0.52.0 is available from PyPI. Next steps: fast-forward Plexus develop from main, merge refreshed develop into the living-report integration branch, upgrade the dependency and lock, resolve integration conflicts, and run the disabled-hosted-CI workflow locally before release review.
